data.explanation: This is an invoice for car maintenance work completed on your vehicle. The workshop asks for payment within 21 days of the invoice date; the app will show the deadline. When transferring the money, use the invoice number WR-25-04417 as the payment reference (Verwendungszweck), as requested. If you disagree with any item on the invoice, contact the workshop directly - no legal remedy procedure applies here. No other action is needed once payment is made.
